benchmark.purpose: Small true-FE limit-point and post-limit path benchmark; not the WP06-C algebraic toy.
benchmark.why_selected: The repository already has a common-driver two-element TET4 snap-through route with a signed load-factor path, turning-point diagnostics, checkpoint/restart and rollback evidence. It exercises real FE assembly while remaining small enough for a bounded three-level contract.

geometry.reference_geometry: M2 and M3 are conforming uniform red refinements of these two parent TET4s; coordinates are edge midpoints and the parent geometry is unchanged.
geometry.imperfection: the nonzero crown rise is part of the frozen geometry; no result-dependent imperfection is allowed

boundary_conditions.fixed_support: nodes 0 and 1 and all descendants of those support vertices: UX=UY=UZ=0
boundary_conditions.symmetry_face: the shared parent face (2,3,4) and all descendants lying on that face: UY=0
boundary_conditions.support_rule: topological parent-face inheritance, resolved deterministically before execution

reference_load.application: one-third point dead load [0,0,-1/3] at each original crown node 2, 3 and 4; these named nodes persist at every refinement level
reference_load.load_factor: lambda multiplies the complete reference vector
reference_load.load_invariance: the three named load nodes and total resultant are unchanged by refinement

monitor.u_monitor: downward crown displacement q = -mean(UZ at nodes 2,3,4)
monitor.reference_coordinates: the three original crown nodes, retained in M2/M3

expected_path.pre_limit_branch: lambda increases from zero while q follows the prescribed load direction
expected_path.limit_point: first local maximum of lambda as a function of q on the accepted path
expected_path.post_limit_branch: q continues along the selected displacement branch while lambda reverses sign of its increment
expected_path.limit_point_detection: three consecutive accepted points with positive then non-positive lambda increments, with q continuity; no exact landing on the theoretical point is required
expected_path.branch_switching: not attempted; only the continuation branch selected by the frozen orientation policy is qualified

mesh_series.parent_cells: one conforming 8-subtet red refinement of M1
two conforming 8-subtet red refinements of M1

mesh_generation.subdivision: each TET4 becomes four corner tetrahedra plus four central tetrahedra using the deterministic diagonal joining midpoint(ab) to midpoint(cd)
mesh_generation.global_node_policy: edge midpoint keyed by sorted parent vertex pair; shared edges reuse one node
mesh_generation.orientation_policy: reject zero-volume children; if signed volume is negative, swap the final two child vertices; record the repaired connectivity
mesh_generation.conformity: shared parent faces use the same three edge-midpoint IDs and identical child-face sets

expected_analytical_sanity.use: diagnostic scale and turning-direction check only; not a TET4 acceptance oracle

primary.implementation: separate direct implementation of the two-parent-TET4 StVK internal energy/tangent and frozen load/BC mapping; no QF production assembly or arc-length routines
primary.formulation_mapping: same M1/M2/M3 coordinates, TET4 connectivity, material, BC, reference load, monitor and spherical constraint

path_comparison.parameter: normalized accepted-path arclength from the pre-limit reference station to the declared post-limit endpoint
path_comparison.interpolation: piecewise linear in accepted-path arclength, frozen before execution

continuation_policy.orientation_policy: target-load direction initially; previous displacement projection first; previous load increment only as tie-breaker; preserve displacement branch through lambda reversal
continuation_policy.retry_policy: rollback committed state before any retry; no altered-physics retry; every rejection is recorded
continuation_policy.termination: max_steps after the declared post-limit window; no target-load stop

linear_solver_policy.fallback_policy: NONE; unsupported or failed augmented solve is typed and fail-closed
linear_solver_policy.cg_minres: not valid by default for the generally nonsymmetric augmented matrix

evidence_requirements.structural_results: required for WP06-D formal points; absent in Phase 0
